title: How can we prevent food shortages?

vocabulary.meaning: reliable access to enough safe and nutritious food
examples: Food security is an important idea when discussing how can we prevent food shortages?.
Learning about food security can help us understand this issue more clearly.

vocabulary.meaning: a situation in which there is not enough of something that is needed
examples: People often have different views about shortage when discussing how can we prevent food shortages?.
Understanding shortage can make a conversation about this topic more precise.

vocabulary.meaning: the amount of food produced from a particular area of farmland
examples: The topic of how can we prevent food shortages? raises useful questions about crop yield.
We can discuss how crop yield affects people, communities, or the environment.

vocabulary.meaning: the network of steps involved in producing and delivering a product
examples: Supply chain can play an important role in debates about how can we prevent food shortages?.
Different countries may deal with supply chain in different ways.

vocabulary.meaning: an extreme shortage of food affecting a large number of people
examples: A discussion about how can we prevent food shortages? can include the effects of famine.
Knowing the meaning of famine makes it easier to express an opinion on this issue.

vocabulary.meaning: the ability to recover from difficulties and continue functioning
examples: Resilience is useful vocabulary for talking about how can we prevent food shortages?.
We can use the idea of resilience to compare different experiences and viewpoints.
